_comment: Operator policy, NOT provider evidence. These are well-known Mantle mainnet contracts an agent is expected to interact with; an allowlisted spender or protocol passes the identity check without a Nansen round-trip, while an UNKNOWN one does not by itself gate a decision (see the 'minimize reviews' rule posture). Addresses were verified against each protocol's official docs/GitHub; replace or extend via the RINNE_GUARD_CONFIG env path. Risk still comes from rule math (unlimited approval, low health factor) and explicit high-risk Nansen labels, never from absence here.
